content.thinking:
Hebrew page with share-index deposit content; the rewrite should be in Hebrew, 1-2 short sentences, first person.

הדף בעברית מציג אפשרויות להשקעה במדד, ורק "ת"א-125" כבר מסומן. אני מזין את הסכומים הקיימים, 10,000 ו-500 בהפקדה החודשית, ומשאיר אותם כמו שהם.
The savings plan shows about 86,000 ₪ after ten years on the chosen option, and I'm skipping the 85,015 figure with its −1,030 difference. I'll look at the account list next.

הרשימה הזולה ביותר היא פסגות (86,045), והבנקים הגדולים גבוהים ממנה בכ-3,000 עד 5,000; אני לא אתייחס לשורות ההערה החוזרות על "לא בחישוב מחיר אחר לצעירים, לחיילים", כי הן לא נוגעות אליך. הסימונים הצבעוניים באתר לא ברורים לי, ואני בודק מה הם אומרים.

The colour key sits only at the bottom of the list, and the orange and red look close together, so I'm not going back up. The fund's figures and the minus sign on its return worry me, and I'll check the other screen next.

content.text:
Every fund here has a minus: "−0.37%", "−0.39%", "−0.54%", and "−1,733 ₪". All red-ish feelings.
At the bottom it explains: "מול המדד: כמה הקרן הקדימה (+) או פיגרה (−) אחרי המדד". So the minus means it fell behind the מדד, not that it lost money? I think so. The first one, −0.04%, is behind by the least.
That's eight screens. My eyes are tired, I'm stopping here.

**What I'd tell my son:**

I haven't decided anything yet. I'll talk to you, and maybe the bank, before I put in a shekel. From what the page shows, the cheapest is an account at "פסגות" with the fund "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125", number 5112628. With 10,000 ₪ now and 500 a month for 10 years, which comes to 70,000 ₪ put in, it says I'd have about 86,045 ₪ "בכסף של היום". At the big banks, Leumi or Hapoalim, it would be about 81,000–83,000, so the bank would take a few thousand more. I'm only half sure. That 86,045 assumes "תשואה בשנה 7%", and I don't know where that 7% comes from. Every fund also had a minus next to it. The note at the bottom says the minus only means it was behind the מדד, but it still makes me nervous. And פסגות isn't my bank.

**Short account:**
- **What I looked at:** The title, the amount boxes (I kept the numbers they had), the big result 86,045 against 85,015, the list of banks and investment houses with their amounts, the box with the fund's details, the list of funds with their minuses, and the note explaining the minus.
- **What I skipped:** The English buttons (MSCI, S&P 500), the coloured bars, and the "לא בחישוב" lines about soldiers and students. I didn't open any of the folds.
- **Where I hesitated:** At the "−1,030" and "−0.04%", and at the red on the אי.בי.אי bar.
- **What I'm not sure I read right:** The colour key is at the bottom of the list, far from the bars it explains, and the orange and red look almost the same to me. I'm also not sure whether the minus means a loss or only falling behind.
- **What wore me out:** The same lines repeated on every row, and the dark screen with so many numbers. I stopped after eight screens.
